title: Claudine Barretto mulls legal action vs Cristy Fermin over ‘damaging’ remarks
summary: Claudine Barretto’s camp issued a cease-and-desist letter to showbiz columnist Cristy Fermin and her co-host Romel Chika over her alleged “untruthful, scandalous, and damaging”…

blocks.text: Claudine Barretto’s camp issued a cease-and-desist letter to showbiz columnist Cristy Fermin and her co-host Romel Chika over her alleged “untruthful, scandalous, and damaging” remarks about the actress’ mental health and recent hospitalization. During Fermin’s “Showbiz Now Na” vlog on Oct. 17, she and Romel talked about the actress, citing Claudine’s recent social media posts showing herself at the hospital. “Si Claudine Barretto mismo ang naglabas sa kanyang IG na nasa hospital siya… pero walang sinabi kung anong dahilan ng kanyang confinement,” Fermin said, then echoed apparent netizen comments saying, “Bakit?
